Watch & Listen to this old gem from the movie, Jay Vejay starring Jeetendra, Reena Roy in the lead roles. The song is sung by Legendary Asha Bhosle & Bhupinder Singh.
Song: SONE JAISI TUMHARI JAWANI
Singer(s): BHUPINDER SINGH, USHA MANGESHKAR, ASHA BHOSLE
Music Director: RAJESH ROSHAN
Lyricist: MAJROOH SULTANPURI
